snapshot.text: Mixed public-private system expanding health insurance through the ARCH programme, starting with the poorest. A National Health Development Plan 2026–2030 was validated, and the government funds free lifesaving emergency care.

priorities.title: ARCH health insurance
priorities.text: Health insurance under ARCH is rolled out commune by commune, with fingerprint readers in hospitals.

priorities.title: Free emergency care
priorities.text: 1 billion CFA francs released to make lifesaving emergency care free.
